title: China's eating our lunch in Latin America. Trump's new coalition is the cure
text:
Washington has spent too long treating Latin America as a problem to be managed rather than a strategic neighborhood to be strengthened. As the United States approaches the 2026 midterm elections, policymakers should recognize an opportunity hiding in plain sight: expanding the Shield of the Americas into a durable hemispheric partnership spanning security, energy, critical minerals, infrastructure, and trade.

The stakes are no longer theoretical.
